details.expected: Requirements. Ordinary category B permits a passenger car or light goods vehicle with a total weight of no more than 3,500 kg. For trailers, either the trailer's total weight is at most 750 kg, or, if above 750 kg, the car and trailer's combined total weights must not exceed 3,500 kg. The first route can therefore permit a combination up to 4,250 kg; it does not mean every 4,250 kg combination is permitted on ordinary B. Category B · Car with trailer

details.expected: Extended B (B96) permits combined total weights up to 4,250 kg, without increasing the car's 3,500 kg limit. Under the ordinary current BE rule, the towing car is still limited to 3,500 kg total weight and the trailer or trailers may have combined total weights up to 3,500 kg. Older entitlements and conditions can differ; check the individual licence rather than applying a current-new-licence example to everyone. This book is not a full B96 or BE course. Trailer entitlement guide

details.expected: Two tests. Entitlement uses registered total weights. Technical towing limits also restrict what the particular car may pull in its actual loaded state. details.expected: Vehicle comparison · Light lorry without a trailer. A light lorry (lätt lastbil) has a registered total weight of at most 3,500 kg. Without a trailer, it normally follows the road's maximum speed; the general heavy-lorry cap does not apply. A heavy lorry exceeds 3,500 kg: without a trailer its vehicle maximum is 90 km/h on a motorway or expressway, and 80 km/h on other roads; with a trailer it is 80 km/h. A lower road limit always applies. For a light lorry towing, check the combination rules in M08-L02. Transportstyrelsen: light and heavy lorries

details.expected: On roads other than private roads, the ordinary width/load rule restricts a motor vehicle or its trailer if the load projects more than 20 cm beyond either side, or the overall width including load exceeds 260 cm. The general length ceiling for a non-bus vehicle or combination is 24.0 m including load; special regimes and exemptions exist. Do not treat those general ceilings as permission to exceed a lower vehicle, route or sign limit. Special oversized transport needs its own verification. Traffic Regulation, chapter 4 §§15–17

details.expected: For a conventional light braked trailer with rigid drawbar and suitable overrun brake, the maximum is normally 80 km/h. For an unbraked trailer up to 750 kg, 80 km/h requires its total weight to be no more than half the car’s defined ready weight; when the trailer is empty, its ready weight is used for this comparison instead. The ordinary unbraked combination outside those conditions is limited to 40 km/h, subject to the other combination requirements; other configurations can be limited to 30. Use Transportstyrelsen's calculator and guidance for the specific combination, and obey any lower road limit. Trailer guide: speed conditions · Traffic Regulation, chapter 4 §20, version applicable on 1 October 2026

details.expected: Towball load · A separate force. Towball load (kultryck) is the trailer's downward load at the coupling, not the trailer's whole loaded weight. With a conventional towball behind the car's rear axle, excessive downward force acts through a lever arm: it increases rear loading while reducing the load carried by the front axle. Front unloading does not require the wheels to leave the road. With less front-tyre loading, available steering grip and response can be impaired. Official towing guide: front-wheel unloading, page 6

details.expected: Inspection deadline · An automatic ban. If the required periodic inspection deadline is missed, an automatic driving ban (inträtt körförbud) applies. You remain responsible even without a reminder. Booking a later appointment does not end the ban. The deadline ban lasts until the inspection has been carried out; follow its result, since defects can bring a new prohibition or a repair/reinspection requirement. Check the vehicle record before ordinary use. Transportstyrelsen: missed inspection · Vehicle Regulation, chapter 6 §§15–21

details.expected: Restricted trips. With an overdue-inspection ban and on-road status (påställd), only the shortest suitable route to a repair workshop for repair or to an inspection business for inspection is permitted. If the vehicle is off-road (avställd) and the ban still applies, the exception is the shortest suitable route to the nearest inspection business. Traffic insurance and other applicable requirements still matter; the off-road exception requires no unpaid vehicle taxes. It does not permit errands or commuting. A prohibition issued because the vehicle is dangerously defective has different conditions: it must be recovered from the place where that prohibition is issued. Transportstyrelsen: inspection prohibitions · Transportstyrelsen: off-road inspection conditions

details.expected: ABS is anti-lock braking. It helps retain the ability to develop steering and braking forces together, within available friction. expected_segments: Requirements. Ordinary category B permits a passenger car or light goods vehicle with a total weight of no more than 3,500 kg. For trailers, either the trailer's total weight is at most 750 kg, or, if above 750 kg, the car and trailer's combined total weights must not exceed 3,500 kg. The first route can therefore permit a combination up to 4,250 kg; it does not mean every 4,250 kg combination is permitted on ordinary B. Category B · Car with trailer

checks.name: M08-L01/teaching-003 reader content and answer reveal

expected_segments: Extended B (B96) permits combined total weights up to 4,250 kg, without increasing the car's 3,500 kg limit. Under the ordinary current BE rule, the towing car is still limited to 3,500 kg total weight and the trailer or trailers may have combined total weights up to 3,500 kg. Older entitlements and conditions can differ; check the individual licence rather than applying a current-new-licence example to everyone. This book is not a full B96 or BE course. Trailer entitlement guide

checks.name: M08-L01/teaching-004 reader content and answer reveal

expected_segments: Two tests. Entitlement uses registered total weights. Technical towing limits also restrict what the particular car may pull in its actual loaded state. Emptying a trailer may reduce its actual weight without changing its registered total weight, so it may solve a technical-weight problem but not an entitlement problem. Towing weights

checks.name: M08-L01/teaching-005 reader content and answer reveal

expected_segments: Vehicle comparison · Light lorry without a trailer. A light lorry (lätt lastbil) has a registered total weight of at most 3,500 kg. Without a trailer, it normally follows the road's maximum speed; the general heavy-lorry cap does not apply. A heavy lorry exceeds 3,500 kg: without a trailer its vehicle maximum is 90 km/h on a motorway or expressway, and 80 km/h on other roads; with a trailer it is 80 km/h. A lower road limit always applies. For a light lorry towing, check the combination rules in M08-L02. Transportstyrelsen: light and heavy lorries

checks.name: M08-L01/teaching-006 reader content and answer reveal

expected_segments: Apply the limit. A light lorry without a trailer on a road signed 100 km/h does not acquire an 80 km/h cap simply because it is called a lorry. Still reduce speed for visibility, grip, traffic and load; a maximum is not a target. Safe-speed duty, chapter 3 §14

expected_segments: Term
Meaning for this lesson
Tjänstevikt
Vehicle in its defined ready-for-use state; a car's figure includes the driver, while a trailer's does not include cargo.
Totalvikt
Registered maximum weight, built from the defined unladen/ready weight and maximum load.
Bruttovikt
Actual weight transmitted to the road at that time.
Maximilast
Total weight minus the defined ready weight: the maximum passenger/cargo load.

checks.name: M08-L02/teaching-009 reader content and answer reveal

expected_segments: Towball load · A separate force. Towball load (kultryck) is the trailer's downward load at the coupling, not the trailer's whole loaded weight. With a conventional towball behind the car's rear axle, excessive downward force acts through a lever arm: it increases rear loading while reducing the load carried by the front axle. Front unloading does not require the wheels to leave the road. With less front-tyre loading, available steering grip and response can be impaired. Official towing guide: front-wheel unloading, page 6

checks.name: M08-L02/teaching-010 reader content and answer reveal

expected_segments: Trafikverket warns that incorrect coupling pressure can lift the car or trailer. Follow the specified towball, coupling, axle and vehicle limits for the actual combination; there is no universal number in this lesson. Measure and redistribute the load as instructed before travelling. Total trailer weight, coupling load and cargo securing are separate checks. Do not cure excessive downward load by guessing or creating an equally unsuitable load distribution. Trafikverket: coupling-load caution · Official towing guide: ratings and load distribution

checks.name: M08-L02/teaching-011 reader content and answer reveal

expected_segments: Your goal: Build an ownership checklist for registration, insurance, inspection and vehicle status.

checks.name: M08-L03/teaching-002 reader content and answer reveal

expected_segments: Requirements. The registered owner of an on-road car must have compulsory motor insurance. Not using the car, or having a defect or driving prohibition, does not by itself end that obligation; formal off-road status matters. Compulsory insurance covers specified traffic injuries and damage to others, not every loss to your own car. Optional cover varies by policy. Compulsory motor insurance

checks.name: M08-L03/teaching-003 reader content and answer reveal

expected_segments: For an ordinary car or light goods vehicle up to 3,500 kg, the normal inspection sequence is: first by 36 months after the month of first use, second by 24 months after the first inspection month, then by 14 months after the preceding inspection month. Check the recorded date and any special category or exemption for your vehicle. An earlier inspection changes the next calculation; an old reminder is not proof of the current deadline. Inspection intervals

checks.name: M08-L03/teaching-004 reader content and answer reveal

expected_segments: An on-road registration status, valid insurance and completed inspection answer different questions. Check the vehicle's status and any prohibition before use, and deal with tax obligations through the current official service. A car being physically driveable does not establish legal readiness. On-road and off-road status

checks.name: M08-L03/teaching-005 reader content and answer reveal

expected_segments: Ownership process. Transportstyrelsen currently provides eligible private-person transfers through Mina sidor; other cases may require the latest registration certificate part 2. The service has eligibility conditions. Consult the current instructions instead of relying on an old app or a remembered screen sequence. Part 1 and the vehicle enquiry service provide technical information; protect ownership documents appropriately. Ownership transfer · Registration certificate

checks.name: M08-L03/production-0001 reader content and answer reveal

expected_segments: Resolve a missed inspection

checks.name: M08-L03/teaching-006 reader content and answer reveal

expected_segments: Inspection deadline · An automatic ban. If the required periodic inspection deadline is missed, an automatic driving ban (inträtt körförbud) applies. You remain responsible even without a reminder. Booking a later appointment does not end the ban. The deadline ban lasts until the inspection has been carried out; follow its result, since defects can bring a new prohibition or a repair/reinspection requirement. Check the vehicle record before ordinary use. Transportstyrelsen: missed inspection · Vehicle Regulation, chapter 6 §§15–21

checks.name: M08-L03/teaching-007 reader content and answer reveal

expected_segments: Restricted trips. With an overdue-inspection ban and on-road status (påställd), only the shortest suitable route to a repair workshop for repair or to an inspection business for inspection is permitted. If the vehicle is off-road (avställd) and the ban still applies, the exception is the shortest suitable route to the nearest inspection business. Traffic insurance and other applicable requirements still matter; the off-road exception requires no unpaid vehicle taxes. It does not permit errands or commuting. A prohibition issued because the vehicle is dangerously defective has different conditions: it must be recovered from the place where that prohibition is issued. Transportstyrelsen: inspection prohibitions · Transportstyrelsen: off-road inspection conditions

checks.name: M08-L03/teaching-008 reader content and answer reveal

expected_segments: Worked deadline. An ordinary light car's recorded inspection deadline is 31 October 2026. Without the required inspection, the deadline ban starts on 1 November. An appointment on 5 November does not allow normal driving on 2 November. Arrange a permitted inspection trip, or transport if it cannot be driven safely and lawfully, then follow the inspection result. These dates illustrate the rule; use the actual vehicle's record. Vehicle Regulation, chapter 6 §§15 and 21

checks.name: M08-L03/teaching-009 reader content and answer reveal

expected_segments: Worked decision. A buyer collects an on-road car but assumes the seller's insurance is enough for the trip home. The buyer checks the transfer and arranges the required cover from the applicable ownership date before driving. The sale does not transfer the seller's insurance as personal cover for the buyer.

These functions can help, but a good safety rating is not a promise that any collision can be avoided.
